summary: Sampler that plays the song's waves (wavetable slots, from wave_import) and built-in samples: 16 zones by key and velocity range, each with its wave, root, tune, level, pan, start, end, loop with crossfade, gate or one-shot, reverse and a choke group; a wave slot's layers split its keys by root or alternate round robin; amp and filter envelopes, velocity to level and filter, pitch bend; Kit mode puts zone n on key Kit base + n − 1 as a one-shot drum. Use it for drum kits, sampled instruments and one-shots.
use_for: Play the song's waves across the keyboard with key zones, loops and filters.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Instrument: each zone plays the notes in its key and velocity ranges, tuned from its root; Kit: zone n plays key Kit base + n − 1 at its own pitch, one-shot (key and velocity ranges, root, loop and trigger aside)

parameters.name: Kit base
parameters.description: The key zone 1 plays in Kit mode (36 = C2, General MIDI's kick: zone 3 is D2 the snare, 7 F#2 the closed hat, 11 A#2 the open hat); the others follow a semitone apart

parameters.name: Polyphony
parameters.description: Voices that sound at once (each zone a note plays takes one); past it a new voice takes the quietest released one, else the oldest, fading it out in 3 ms

parameters.name: Bend range
parameters.description: Pitch bend range

parameters.name: Vel → amp
parameters.description: How much velocity sets the level: the gain is velocity^(2 × this) (100 %: velocity 64 is −12 dB; 0 %: every note at full level)

parameters.name: Vel crossfade
parameters.description: Zones whose velocity ranges meet crossfade (equal power) over this many velocity steps around the boundary instead of switching; 0 switches

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level

parameters.name: Amp attack
parameters.description: Attack time (the shortest, 0.5 ms, keeps a note starting mid-wave from clicking)

parameters.name: Amp decay
parameters.description: Decay time (to −60 dB of the way to sustain)

parameters.name: Amp sustain
parameters.description: Sustain level

parameters.name: Amp release
parameters.description: Release time after the note ends (to −60 dB)

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Filter on every voice: off, ladder low-pass 24 or 12 dB/oct, state-variable band-pass or high-pass

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.description: Cutoff

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: Resonance (the ladder self-oscillates at the top)

parameters.name: Filter env
parameters.description: Filter envelope amount (±6 octaves)

parameters.name: Key track
parameters.description: Cutoff follows the keyboard around C4 (100 %: an octave per octave)

parameters.name: Filter vel
parameters.description: Softer notes close the filter (up to 3 octaves at the lowest velocity)

parameters.name: Flt attack
parameters.description: Attack time

parameters.name: Flt decay
parameters.description: Decay time

parameters.name: Flt sustain
parameters.description: Sustain level

parameters.name: Flt release
parameters.description: Release time

parameters.name: Z1 wave
parameters.description: Zone 1's wave: 0 off, 1–200 a slot of the song's wavetable (wave_import), 201 on a built-in sample (the manual lists them)

parameters.name: Z1 key low
parameters.description: Zone 1: the lowest key it plays (Instrument mode)

parameters.name: Z1 key high
parameters.description: Zone 1: the highest key it plays (Instrument mode)

parameters.name: Z1 vel low
parameters.description: Zone 1: the lowest velocity it plays (Instrument mode)

parameters.name: Z1 vel high
parameters.description: Zone 1: the highest velocity it plays (Instrument mode)

parameters.name: Z1 root
parameters.description: Zone 1: the key that plays the wave unchanged; 128, Wave, takes each layer's own root from the wavetable (Instrument mode)

parameters.name: Z1 tune
parameters.description: Zone 1: transposition

parameters.name: Z1 fine
parameters.description: Zone 1: fine tune, in 0.1 cent steps

parameters.name: Z1 level
parameters.description: Zone 1: level

parameters.name: Z1 pan
parameters.description: Zone 1: pan (a stereo wave: balance)

parameters.name: Z1 start
parameters.description: Zone 1: where it starts, in % of the wave (the end, reversed)

parameters.name: Z1 end
parameters.description: Zone 1: where it ends, in % of the wave (the start, reversed); it fades out over 2 ms before it

parameters.name: Z1 loop
parameters.description: Zone 1: Wave loops as the wavetable says (its loop points and type), Off plays through, Forward and Ping-pong loop between loop start and loop end

parameters.name: Z1 loop start
parameters.description: Zone 1: loop start, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)

parameters.name: Z1 loop end
parameters.description: Zone 1: loop end, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)

parameters.name: Z1 crossfade
parameters.description: Zone 1: a forward loop's crossfade (equal power), from the samples before loop start (after loop end, reversed); at most the loop's length and the room there is

parameters.name: Z1 trigger
parameters.description: Zone 1: Gate plays while the note is held, then releases; One-shot plays to the end and ignores note-offs and loops (Kit mode is one-shot)

parameters.name: Z1 reverse
parameters.description: Zone 1: plays backwards, from its end to its start

parameters.name: Z1 choke
parameters.description: Zone 1: choke group 1–8 (0 off): a note in a group fades out, in 5 ms, every voice of the group still sounding (closed and open hats)
